name: Tokita Tsubame
source: Elder sister of the twins Chidori and Koruri when Jun's father marries her mother she becomes his elder sister as well. She helps explain to Jun how to treat succubi through sex. As a teacher she helps Jun find places around the school grounds where he can have sex with her sisters without being caught. Her eyes turn red when in her succubus form.
